messages:
Maya R: Quick random question to spice up the feed — if you could keep only 3 physical objects for the rest of your life (no digital backups allowed), what would they be? 🤔
Samir: My passport, a pocket knife, and a paperback copy of 'Hitchhiker's Guide' (for moral support).
Devin: Solar charger, multimeter, and a ridiculously comfy hoodie. Practicality wins.
Arjun: Easel + paints (I can make stuff), a bike (mobility), and my late grandma's recipe book.
Liz: One weighted blanket (sleep...), a cheap but reliable coffee maker, and a tiny photo album.
Maya R: Loving the variety. follow-up: assume food/water/shelter handled, these are 'keepsakes/tools' only.
Samir: lol ok then maybe switch passport -> a Swiss Army knife with tiny screwdriver bits. Also a tiny notebook + pen.
Devin: Also: can we count a multi-tool as one item that is like, everything? if yes then multimeter becomes optional. :laughing: 
Arjun: Rules: no charging for digital stuff, so no phone. That makes the easel choice feel very extra but worth it.
Liz: vote: weighted blanket > coffee maker > photo album — reactions please :ballot_box_with_ballot:
ops-bot: Poll created (expires in 24h): weighted blanket / coffee maker / photo album — vote with :one: :two: :three:.
Maya R: ok I'm casting :two: because I need coffee to be a functioning human.
Samir: :one: for the blanket.
Devin: :one: Blanket for naps in weird timezone meetings.
Arjun: :three: sentimental pick.
Liz: :two: for the coffee maker (can't argue with caffeine utility).
Maya R: Thanks y'all — this was therapeutic :) Any wild 'object' picks you think we missed?
